summary: Wrote a 6-phase plan. A plan-time read of context/standards/anchor-pointer-convention.md found the constraint ALREADY has a durable, index-registered home: its '## The Two Hard Exclusion Classes' section states the exclusion class, the behaviour-change consequence, and the derivation rule verbatim, and names both enforcers. The research report had dismissed that file as documenting only itself, so its PLACEMENT decision (a new gate-enforced-fragment-duplication.md) is superseded: the plan extends the existing record instead of minting a second, drift-prone home for the derivation rule. The residual gap is the DISCOVERY PATH, which the plan closes with four independent hooks (index keywords, task-breakdown.md's planning surface, documentation-standards.md, and a pointer comment in each enforcing lint header - territory now free, the originating record is completed), plus a before/after finding-set diff of gates 6 and 9 against a freshly deployed tree.
